reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates robust superconductivity persisting under pressure in a similar HEA, but provides no data on the electronic density of states or its pressure dependence, leaving the core mechanistic premises unsupported.
premises: Pressure-induced lattice compression enhances the electronic density of states at the Fermi level in the HEA.
The enhanced density of states sustains robust electron–phonon pairing and superconductivity.
The HEA remains in a disordered BCC structure without phase transition up to ~60 GPa.
Tc shows minimal variation or slight enhancement under pressure up to ~60 GPa.
